content.title: Know before you go: Luke Combs headlining show at Jack Trice Stadium
content.text: 'Ain't No Love in Oklahoma' - but thousands are prepared to show country music superstar Luke Combs some love during his tour stop at Jack Trice Stadium in Ames. Iowa State Athletics says, as of Thursday, nearly 60,000 tickets have been sold for Saturday's show. Whether you're attending the show or want to navigate around the crowds, here's what you will need to know. Concert details Luke Combs is on his "My Kinda Saturday Night Tour". His stop in Ames on Saturday, April 11, is the third stop on the tour. Opening acts for Saturday include Jake Worthington, Thelma & James, Ty Myers, and Dierks Bentley. Tickets can be purchased here. Weather Jack Trice Stadium is not an enclosed stadium, so anyone attending the concert is subject to the elements. There are indoor areas including restrooms and concessions. A few showers are possible around the time that gates open. You can hear a more detailed forecast in the video above. Getting to Ames and to Jack Trice StadiumYou got a fast car, but be aware of some construction that could slow you down.Work is currently underway to prepare for a bridge replacement project on Highway 30 in Ames. The eastbound exit ramp to Dayton Ave. and the on-ramp from northbound Duff Avenue or U.S. 69 to eastbound Highway 30 are closed. Gates to the stadium are located on the north, east and south sides of Jack Trice Stadium. The ticket office as at the north end inside of the Jacobson Building. Anyone who purchased field-level tickets is asked to enter through the north side using Gate 1 for more convenient access.CyRide operates some routes on Saturdays. However, it is making changes to account for closures and heavy traffic the day of the concert. More information can be found here. Rideshare drivers and users are asked to use the area around C.Y. Stephens Auditorium for pick-up and drop-off. Rideshare vehicles are not allowed in parking areas and will not be allowed to stop traffic to drop off or pick up passengers. After the concert, there will be no access to eastbound Highway 30 from Dayton Avenue. The city of Ames does this on typical football game days to limit traffic backups. Instead, drivers will be rerouted north to East 13th Street, to I-35. ParkingLots open at noon. Cars staged or parked near the entrance of each lot may be asked to move at any time in advance of the scheduled opening time for the parking lot. When lots open, drivers will be directed to an available spot in the parking zone they purchased. RV Village parking can be purchased here. What to bring into Jack Trice StadiumIowa State Athletics has a clear bag policy for all ticketed events. These can be plastic, vinyl, or PVC clear totes as long as they are no bigger than 12 inches tall, six inches wide, and 12 inches long. All tickets are mobile. Concert-goers are asked to download their tickets to their mobile wallet before arriving at the stadium to make entering easier. Jack Trice Stadium is a fully cashless venue. Credit cards, debit cards, and mobile pay are accepted for parking, concessions, and merchandise.Permitted items include one 20-ounce unopened or empty non-metal water bottle per person, items for medical or child care needs, blankets, and backless cushions. Prohibited items include umbrellas, seat cushions with a back, cameras and video cameras, and cigarettes or vapes. Once you are allowed in, you are not able to leave and reenter.Before acts take the stageA pre-concert tailgate is scheduled from 3 p.m. to 5:30 p.m. at the south end of the stadium in Reiman Plaza. A concert ticket is required to go. Gates for concert-goers to find their seats will open at 5 p.m. The first act will take the stage at 5:20 p.m.What songs could Luke Combs play?The exact setlist for Saturday's show has not been released, but here's what some fans have reported hearing at one recent show.
